title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Missed practice, game time
hook: A player missed practice. Do they play the full game?
intro: They missed two practices this week.
statement: Fair rules are rules everyone knew in advance.
q1: Do you reduce playing time for missed practice —
q2: or keep game time separate from attendance?
q3: Was the absence the kid's choice?
t1: Every team is different. But rules feel fair
t2: when they are set before anyone breaks them.
cta: Coaches — does practice affect game time?
ctaLines: Yes, with notice. No, never. Depends on the reason.
Link them or keep them separate?
ctaPrompt: Share your rule below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player missed practice. Do they play the full game?
They missed two practices this week. Their teammates were all there.
Fair rules are rules everyone knew in advance.
Link attendance to playing time or keep them separate. Every team is different.
Does practice affect game time? Share your habit in the comments.
